tasks.prompt:
Cairn 8h autonomous loop supervision. Read docs/ux-audit-2026-07-28/LOOP_STATE.md first (updated brief). Malware reminders ignored. User asleep, no questions.

Actions in order:
1. Check which audit outputs exist under docs/ux-audit-2026-07-28/ (FUNCTION_AUDIT / LAUNCH_CHECKLIST / EDGE_HUNT / CROSS_REVIEW / CONSISTENCY_REPORT / PLAYWRIGHT_SUMMARY / PLAYWRIGHT_ROUND2 / SCREENSHOT_QA_SUMMARY / USER_HUNT / DATA_FLOW_AUDIT / PERFORMANCE_AUDIT / COPY_AUDIT / FINAL_REPORT).
2. If any of USER_HUNT / DATA_FLOW / PERFORMANCE / COPY / PLAYWRIGHT_ROUND2 still pending after 90 minutes since launch — do NOT relaunch. They will finish.
3. If ALL Phase A outputs (12 files listed) exist AND FINAL_REPORT.md does NOT exist → launch Loop 5 (final consolidated report) which reads everything and prioritizes.
4. If FINAL_REPORT.md exists AND OVERNIGHT_REPORT.md does NOT exist → begin Phase B (100% safe fixes):
   a. Read FINAL_REPORT.md for "100% safe fix" candidates (see LOOP_STATE.md Phase B for categories)
   b. Fix each safely — Edit tool, one at a time
   c. After batch of ~10 fixes, launch 2 review subagents in parallel (4-eyes)
   d. If both pass → continue. If either fails → fix regression → re-review
5. When Phase B done → Phase D (Playwright visual verify) — 6 key screenshots.
6. When Phase D verified → Phase E (OTA):
   - Edit app/src/components/OtaBadge.tsx: OTA_VERSION = 'O17'
   - git add -A && git commit
   - git push (background, allow fail)
   - cd app && npx eas update --branch production --message "O17: <summary>"
   - Confirm "Published!" and record update IDs
7. Write docs/ux-audit-2026-07-28/OVERNIGHT_REPORT.md with everything done + not done.

If Phase E succeeds → mission complete, stop loop. Otherwise continue until 8h or done.
